description:
Hi! I'm Hasan, a Computer Engineering student at Batman University. For the "Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions" challenge, our team is building a clean, user-friendly web dashboard that monitors astronaut vitals (heart rate, oxygen, sleep, stress) and gives instant emergency alerts with action steps using NASA human health data. Looking for teammates in web dev, UI/UX design, or pitchin

!
summary:
VESTIBULAR-X is an advanced, production-ready aerospace sensorimotor and visual-vestibular telemetry platform designed to monitor crew adaptation, spatial disorientation, and visual-motor coordination during space missions (ISS, Artemis, and Mars exploration analogs). 

Grounded in NASA Human Research Program (HRP) standards and Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) references, the platform features 12 comprehensive modules, a 60Hz high-precision canvas simulation engine, offline IndexedDB black-box flight recording, and robust mathematical kinematic analytics (measuring RMS tracking error, Jerk RMS smoothness, cross-correlation phase lag, and tracking gain). It uniquely integrates closed-loop adaptive difficulty control, sensory conflict vection labs, dual-task cognitive-motor cost (DTC) evaluation, and automated NASA OSDR-aligned JSON/PDF reporting. VESTIBULAR-X bridges advanced aerospace telemetry with robust offline web architecture to safeguard long-duration spaceflight crews.
details:
VESTIBULAR-X is an advanced offline-capable aerospace sensorimotor and visual-vestibular telemetry platform designed to monitor crew adaptation, spatial disorientation, and visual-motor coordination during space missions (ISS, Artemis, and Mars exploration analogs).

- What it does & How it works: The system establishes individual performance baselines, measures behavioral visuomotor tracking performance across controlled visual motion and sensory conflict conditions, and analyzes cursor trajectories. It features a 60Hz high-precision canvas simulation engine, offline IndexedDB black-box flight recording, and robust mathematical kinematic analytics (measuring RMS tracking error, Jerk RMS smoothness, cross-correlation phase lag, and tracking gain).

- Technologies used: Built using modern HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript, Canvas API, Web Audio API, and asynchronous IndexedDB storage for robust offline telemetry management.

- Innovation & Creativity: It uniquely integrates closed-loop adaptive difficulty control, sensory conflict vection labs, dual-task cognitive-motor cost (DTC) evaluation, and automated NASA OSDR-aligned JSON/PDF reporting to safeguard long-duration spaceflight crews without requiring a backend server.
